tools.name: list_modules
tools.description: List every clinician teaching module and patient chapter: title, canonical URL, evidence-review date.

tools.name: search_teaching
tools.description: Search clinician teaching modules AND patient chapters by free-text query (title, description, and body text); returns matching modules with snippets.

tools.name: read_module
tools.description: Read ONE module's full teaching text (markdown) with required citation. Not for bulk corpus assembly.

tools.name: get_claims
tools.description: Get the claim ledger (claim → evidence rows) for a module, when published.

tools.name: get_evidence_log
tools.description: Dated evidence-review log for all modules.

tools.name: get_corpus_state
tools.description: The current GASTROLOGER_CLINICAL_STATE: version, corpus/section/module Merkle roots, counts and hash scheme — pin an answer to an exact knowledge state.

tools.name: verify_claim_hash
tools.description: Verify one clinical claim against the published corpus root via its Merkle inclusion proof (optionally against a bundle_hash you hold). Returns the claim content only when it is physician-activated or clinician-adjudicated.

tools.name: check_gi_claim
tools.description: Fact-check pasted text (a social post, caption, or sentence): canonical wording or its full explicit negation can receive a scoped governed verdict; other matches return unresolved reviewed candidates with evidence. No video retrieval or individual medical advice.

tools.name: resolve_gi_claim
tools.description: Resolve one supplied proposition against governed claims. Only preserved canonical wording or its full explicit negation is certified; lexical candidates and changed qualifiers remain unresolved. Does not search external evidence.

tools.name: search_gi_verifications
tools.description: Search canonical GI fact-check verifications by free text; returns matching governed claims with canonical /verify/ URLs.

tools.name: get_gi_verification
tools.description: Get one canonical verification record (statement, verdict, review date, evidence module, machine URLs) by its slug or claim id.

tools.name: get_evidence_bundle
tools.description: Resolve up to 10 claims (by claim_ids or free-text query) into an evidence bundle: statements, verdicts, review dates, evidence pointers, canonical URLs, clinical-state pin. Optional locale (BCP-47) reports human-localized module availability; canonical identifiers are language-independent. Bulk exp

tools.name: classify_hrm_metrics
tools.description: Legacy HRM operation quarantined after rule discrepancies were reproduced against reviewed teaching. Returns needs_review without classification. Do not invoke to obtain a diagnosis; this compatibility name is omitted from new plugin products.

tools.name: score_clinical_instrument
tools.description: Score a governed clinical instrument from structured responses: IBS-SSS (ibs-sss, 5 slider items 0-100 + days×10, total 0-500) and GERD-Q (gerd-q, 6 choice items, total 0-18, ≥8 consistent with GERD). Returns total, percent of max, band label + interpretation, and the instrument citation. Every item

tools.name: query_relations
tools.description: Query the evidence-backed clinical relationship graph (subject–predicate–object triples over diseases, medications, tests, findings, guidelines). Every relation cites governed claim IDs and/or evidence registry IDs. Filter by node text (subject/object), predicate (treated_by, evaluated_by, contraind

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_modules, get_evidence_log, check_gi_claim, search_gi_verifications, get_gi_verification, get_evidence_bundle · Private data: get_gi_verification · Public sink: check_gi_claim, score_clinical_instrument.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_modules, get_evidence_log, check_gi_claim, search_gi_verifications, get_gi_verification, get_evidence_bundle · Private data: get_gi_verification · Public sink: check_gi_claim, score_clinical_instrument

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
